title: Expeditions Interphase
description: Lightweight modpack designed for Expeditions Interphase, an in-between season experience.
body:
# Expeditions SMP: Interphase

**The between-seasons server for the Expeditions SMP community.**

---

Season 1 is in the books. Season 2 is being built behind the scenes. In the meantime — we play.

**Interphase** is a vanilla/vanilla+ server running alongside development of Season 2. No heavy mods. No roleplay obligations. No lore pressure. Just Minecraft with the people you already know (and the ones you're about to meet).

The modpack is lightweight on purpose: performance and QoL improvements to keep things running smooth, plus proximity voice chat so you can actually talk to your neighbors. That's it. The focus here is the game itself.

## What this is

- A chill vanilla Minecraft experience with the Expeditions community
- Light QoL and performance mods only
- Proximity voice chat
- A place to hang out and build while Season 2 is in development

## What this isn't

- Season 2. That's coming, and it's going to be worth the wait.
- A lore server. Save your nation-building energy — you'll need it.

---

**JOIN THE DISCORD TO GET WHITELISTED**

Season 2 is coming. Stick around.
